name: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City, UT) Shrimp Ceviche (Fresh Lime Citrus Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Contains concentrated raw lime juice (citrus acid), raw jalapeño peppers, and raw red onion. High risk for heartburn, mucosal burning, and gas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during flares and citrus intolerance. Opt for warm grilled shrimp fajitas or chicken tacos instead.
watchOuts: Raw lime juice citrus acid burns inflamed mucosa
Raw jalapeño and red onion cause severe gas
